name: Apple Home
summary: Your Apple Home rooms, favorite accessories and scenes in the Nook.
capabilities: Requests Apple Home access through the system HomeKit permission
Reads homes, rooms, accessories, scenes and supported characteristic values
Stores its own chosen home and favorite accessory identifiers
Publishes read-only status through the generic plugin SDK
Keeps Apple Home independent from Home Assistant and NeroNook core
Sends reviewed on/off commands only to individually allowed lights, switches and outlets, then checks their state
